name: Jamf Pro API Patterns
description: Jamf Pro MCP fundamentals through Conduit: the three X-Jamf-* credential headers and the API client they come from, the read/write/admin tool tiers and how Conduit and the sidecar each gate them, zero-based paging and RSQL filters on the Jamf Pro API tools, contains/limit on the Classic API list tools, inventory sections, response caps, and the error and rate-limit messages the sidecar returns.
